description.text: is anchored as the opening frame: a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet laid out on a dark charcoal field. The wide top hero panel depicts a lean adult figure in all-black tactical dress standing on a wet urban walkway at night, framed by metal railings on both sides. Thin rain streaks cut across the scene, the pavement holds a mirror-like sheen, and blurred city lights behind the figure separate into warm amber and cool blue-gray pools. The figure's shaved-side dark hair is gathered into a small tied bun at the back; a scar crosses one eyebrow; the high-collared jacket shows strap and buckle details over a dark crew-neck shirt; black cargo trousers and black lace-up combat boots complete the silhouette. Beneath the hero panel, three full-body studio views present front, side-profile, and back angles against the charcoal backdrop, and four cropped detail views isolate the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots. Soft, low-key directional lighting models the fabric and hardware in the studio panels, while the rainy walkway combines a cool key with warm background practicals. The overall palette stays desaturated—black, charcoal gray, cool blue-gray, and warm amber—with a photorealistic dark cinematic finish. The sheet's geometric layout remains stable, giving the subtle motion inside the top panel a framed, almost dioramic quality: rain drifts downward in fine threads, reflected lights tremble across the wet ground, and the figure's hair and jacket edges stir faintly, as if a night breeze has entered only that upper scene.
holds as the exact opening composition, with the multi-panel sheet fully legible and the rainy hero panel already glistening under cool and warm night lights.

Inside the top hero panel, the rain begins a slow downward drift; individual streaks catch the city glow, reflected amber and blue patches waver on the wet walkway, and the figure's tied hair and jacket hem respond to a faint breeze while the lower turnaround and detail panels remain still.

The wet pavement continues to shimmer as blurred background lights expand and contract in soft bokeh; thin rain lines cross the railings and the figure's dark jacket, where the high collar and buckle hardware pick up a restrained warm edge.

The rain and reflections settle into a steady, gentle drift across the hero panel, preserving the composed reference-sheet layout and the crisp studio views below while the nocturnal walkway retains its damp, cinematic atmosphere.
